profile.headline: Software Engineer at IBM
profile.summary: I'm a Full Stack Software Developer with over 10 years of experience, currently serving as UI Lead for an AI platform leveraging deep learning and transfer learning to train and deploy models in advanced image and video processing pipelines. I'm proficient in ReactJS, JavaScript, Java, and Python, with a demonstrated ability to work closely with UX teams to deliver intuitive, scalable solutions. I've successfully designed and built two products from the ground up, with expertise in both front-end and back-end development, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead UI developer for IBM Maximo Visual Inspection and Maximo Visual Inspection Edge, where I am responsible for developing dynamic, responsive, and a user-friendly interface.  
• Spearheaded full-stack development on key features, including data retention and Single Sign-On (SSO), leveraging Java, OpenShift, and Docker to create scalable, secure, and performant solutions.
• Mentor a small team of junior developers, providing guidance on UI tasks, code reviews, and development best practices to improve team productivity. 
• Closely engage with UX designers, client engineering and technical pre-sales to deliver features that cater to diverse use-cases with an emphasis on inspection in manufacturing contexts.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Full stack developer for PowerAI Vision, a deep learning platform used to train and deploy models for image and video processing. 
• Created a user interface from the ground up to deliver a product in five months.  
• Developed key UI components using ReactJS, Redux, JavaScript, HTML, and SCSS, including user-friendly features for labeling images and videos, enhancing usability and model training efficiency.        
• Engineered and implemented robust RESTful APIs using Java, facilitating seamless functionality for labeling, training, and deploying deep learning models. Designed and developed backend services to ensure efficient data handling and integration with the frontend.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Full stack developer for PowerVC, a virtualization management solution for creating scalable, private clouds on Power Systems.
• Developed new RESTful APIs and key cloud virtualization management features such as live migration between PowerVM OpenStack driver and HMC driver, virtual machine capture, and an automated email system, simplifying the creation and deployment of virtual machines on POWER servers.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Developed Python tools and utilities for modeling and data analysis of proprietary engineering data.
• Created a series of computer-based training modules for ER/Studio Data Architect, a data modeling suite.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: • Worked with a team developing a Java Android application used to remotely control custom hardware using a Bluetooth link.  The Android application implemented real time control and configurations of custom hardware used to test cellular networks. Included development of user interface screens and management software.
